description: developer-harness guard hooks (Codex dialect): secrets, large files, merge markers, and the quality gate run before shell tool calls. Codex has no per-command `if` narrowing, so every script no-ops fast when nothing relevant is staged, and quality-gate.sh additionally skips payloads that are not a `git commit`. Declared in .codex-plugin/plugin.json; deliberately NOT named hooks/hooks.json — see hooks/README.md.
